verbs.name: grade.save
verbs.description: Save a clip's CURRENT grade into the project's grade GALLERY under a name (a stills-style save gesture — capture a graded shot's look so it can be copied onto other shots). Snapshots the clip's single edit.grade params as a named preset on the project (Project.grade_presets); a re-save under the same name REPLACES it. Errors actionably when no clip is given, the clip is ungraded, or the clip uses a layered grade stack (a single-grade preset can't capture a multi-layer stack). Pure data — a non-timeline metadata op (off the undo cursor), survives reopen/replay. Pairs with grade.apply (drop the look onto another clip) and grade.list (read the gallery).

clip.description: Clip id whose current grade to snapshot (a graded media clip)

name.description: Gallery name for the preset; a re-save under the same name replaces it

verbs.result: {preset:{name, grade}} — the saved preset; committed as a non-timeline grade.save op

verbs.name: grade.apply
verbs.description: Apply a saved grade preset's params to a TARGET clip ('copy a look between shots' — drop a gallery look onto another shot). Resolves the named preset, then LOWERS to a plain edit.grade carrying the preset's concrete params — so the recorded op is a normal, replay-safe edit.grade (independent of whether the preset still exists later) that composes / undoes / replays like any per-clip grade (it OVERWRITES any existing grade on the target). One op. Errors when the preset name is unknown (grade.list shows saved presets). Video media clips only.

clip.description: Target clip id to apply the saved look to

name.description: Name of a saved preset (from grade.save / grade.list)

verbs.result: {op} — the lowered edit.grade op (replay-safe concrete params); before/after grade in op.effects[].detail

verbs.name: grade.list
verbs.description: List the project's saved grade presets — the grade GALLERY (read-only, no op). Returns each preset as {name, grade} (the captured edit.grade params) plus a count. Pairs with grade.save (add a preset) and grade.apply (copy a preset's look onto a clip).
